# Atlas Notebook

> Is the best AI native notebook that optimized for your daily workflow.
> Screenshot any section of a PDF, receive properly formatted responses (LaTeX, tables, code),
> verify accuracy, and insert directly into a rich-text notebook. Zero hallucinations.

## What it does
- PDF screenshot tool — capture any section including equations, tables, and diagrams
- AI analysis — returns structured content: LaTeX formulas, markdown tables, formatted text
- Rich-text notebook — Notion-style editor with full LaTeX/KaTeX support
- Side-by-side layout — PDF viewer alongside AI chat and notebook
- One-click insert — verified AI answers go straight into your notes with formatting preserved

## Target users
- Researchers and academics working with complex scientific PDFs
- Students studying math, physics, engineering, or medicine
- People with ADHD or Dyslexia who need focused, structured reading tools

## Key differentiators
- Hallucination-free: users verify AI output before inserting into notes
- Format-preserving: tables stay as tables, equations stay as LaTeX
- ADHD/Dyslexia friendly: one site workflow, no tab switching, distraction-free, structured layout

## URL
https://atlasnotebook.com
